candidates.applicability: Applicable to the same frozen evaluation setup and protocol used for the baseline and random-forest candidate; this is a system-integration control and makes no medical-validity or clinical-utility claim.
falsification: If logistic_regression exceeds GaussianNB by a positive difference comparable to the random-forest difference, the nonlinear-interaction explanation for the random-forest gain is weakened.
If logistic_regression fails to exceed GaussianNB while random-forest exceeds it, the linear-relaxation alternative is weakened.
candidates.mechanism: Logistic regression fits a regularized linear decision boundary, so it relaxes GaussianNB's conditional independence assumption without adding nonlinear interactions. It therefore serves as a control for whether the random-forest gain is attributable to nonlinear structure versus additive linear structure.
predictions: If the random-forest gain is driven by nonlinear feature interactions or threshold effects, then logistic_regression will not show a positive diagnostic-label difference over GaussianNB comparable to the random-forest difference; its difference will be smaller and may be zero or negative under the same protocol.

If the random-forest gain is instead explained by merely relaxing GaussianNB's conditional independence with additive linear structure, then logistic_regression will also show a positive diagnostic-label difference over GaussianNB under the same protocol, approaching the random-forest difference.

A negative or near-zero logistic_regression difference together with a positive random-forest difference would disfavor the linear-relaxation alternative and leave nonlinear structure as a more plausible explanation for the integration-check gain.

decisions.rationale: The candidate logistic regression (OBS-d53747a64ef9743cfa) exceeds the GaussianNB baseline (OBS-769c5f6842d74c9037) by 0.0614, above the 0.02 threshold. This supports the linear-relaxation alternative, but an effect threshold is descriptive evidence, not proof of a scientific mechanism. To distinguish whether the gain is due to additive linear structure or nonlinear interactions, a nonlinear control such as svc_rbf (H-bc8dc456319781dc) or extra_trees (H-91e078fe43ed4a40) is needed under the same frozen protocol.
